# Captured 2026-10-24 against a local memory daemon (this environment
# has no Docker; Flight SQL + named sandbox are the same as DuckLake).
#
#   export DUCKBOX_HANDLE_SECRET=duckbox-dev-secret
#   ./build/duckbox serve --daemon ./daemons/memory.yaml --listen 127.0.0.1:4747
#   ./build/duckbox sandbox create --url grpc://127.0.0.1:4747 \
#     --spec ./policies/memory/analyst.yaml \
#     --id acme-analyst --key tenant_21:user_sergio
#   ./build/duckbox sandbox create --url grpc://127.0.0.1:4747 \
#     --spec ./policies/memory/analyst.yaml \
#     --id acme-kim --key tenant_22:user_kim
#   make -C examples/goose-adbc
#   ./examples/goose-adbc/query

$ ./examples/goose-adbc/query
id	title	amount
1	alpha deal	100

$ ./examples/goose-adbc/query --sql 'SELECT count(*) AS n FROM deals'
n
1

$ ./examples/goose-adbc/query --sql 'SELECT * FROM secrets'
query: [FlightSQL] table not allowlisted: memory.main.secrets (InvalidArgument; ExecuteQuery)
# exit 1

$ ./examples/goose-adbc/query --sandbox acme-kim --sql 'SELECT id, title, amount FROM deals ORDER BY id'
id	title	amount
3	bravo deal	500
4	bravo two	50
